title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
blurb:
♫Up to mighty London, Came an Irish cad one day.
Full of quips and prose so bold, So everyone way happy.
Meeting friends like Doyle, Stoker, James, and Queensberry.
Till “Be yourself” ignited, Differing philosophies.♫
